proof_spine: Every generator extension annihilates all radial L2 vectors; positivity and conservation force radial multiplier commutation.
The nonsymmetric R-510 transfer envelope and normalized power bound imply a uniform-column sextic exponential moment.
Increasing full-probability radial events bound the unchanged quadratic label-rate increment by a subpolynomial spatial envelope.
Compact radial cutoffs put localized finite-root backward tests in every generator domain through the original D.
A Poisson dependency estimate and an independent commutator matrix estimate bound the exterior remainder by a factorial tail.
The remainder vanishes for growing support at fixed localization; common comparison and removal of localization force equality on D and then H.
